採用・広告の製品.quote: Yoshi Mobility — Live-Video Vehicle Inspections for Fleets & Rideshare
Yoshi is the live-video inspection platform for transportation networks. Inspections, driver qualifications, and contractor onboarding conducted virtually by qualified experts.
Live-Video Inspection

Uber, Turo, and major transportation networks already trust Yoshi to keep their assets and contractors compliant. AI-powered live video and API-ready signed results give networks the scalable inspection layer their networks demand.

Marketplaces, franchise networks, brokers, and specialty transport operators use Yoshi to qualify assets and operators before they go to work — conducted over live video with signed, auditable results.

Driving with Uber or hosting on Turo? Yoshi makes your required annual inspection fast and hassle-free. Compliant inspections are done over real-time video. We're officially integrated with Uber and trusted by thousands of earners and hosts. Just schedule online, join a quick video call, and receive a digitally-signed inspection form by email instantly.
At your scheduled time, the driver joins the video call on their phone using the link we send. Our inspector will expertly guide them through the inspection steps.

Whether you're onboarding a contractor fleet, building a marketplace, or running a franchise that needs auditable inspection records — Yoshi integrates with your platform. Let's talk about how live-video inspection fits your workflow.
From on-demand gas delivery to live-video vehicle inspections, Yoshi has been redefining how transportation networks keep their vehicles and drivers compliant, since 2015.

Yoshi began in 2015 as a gas delivery service — bringing fuel directly to your vehicle, wherever you parked, using DOT-approved trucks and Hazmat-certified Field Technicians. You downloaded the app, dropped a pin, popped your gas flap, and went on with your day. We handled the rest.

From there we expanded into preventative maintenance and EV charging services, building the technology platform and operational know-how to deliver vehicle services at scale, without the customer ever visiting a shop.

That same DNA to meet customers where they are and use technology to do it efficiently led us to where we are today: live-video vehicle inspections. We traded fuel trucks for video calls, and unlocked something far more scalable: a certified inspection process that works for a single rideshare driver or an entire contractor fleet.

Keep transportation networks moving via live-video inspections that are fast, compliant, and built for scale. From a single rideshare driver to a national fleet, Yoshi makes the inspection process seamless.

From gas delivery to video calls, Yoshi’s technology has continuously evolved to meet the needs of transportation networks. Today, our live-video platform serves rideshare drivers, commercial fleets, and marketplace networks across the country.

We’re expanding what’s possible over live video: qualifying vehicles, operators, and contractors for platforms that need auditable, scalable onboarding. If it can be assessed in real time, Yoshi can deliver it.

米国でロードアシストサービスを手掛けるYoshiが移動式EV充電サービス事業を売却すると発表しました。
売却先はフロリダを中心に移動式燃料補給サービスを手掛けるEzFill社で、社会的なEV普及拡大に対応と事業拡大を目指します。
ここ数年で行っておの高い普及率となったEV関連、徐々に周辺サービスでも動きが出てきました。
